change: For RA, transient stale-attempt DIVERGED or NaN/Inf log tokens may finish one native fresh retry. Hard PETSc/MPI/OOM errors remain fatal; fresh retry failure and final nonfinite/nonconverged nonlinear rows remain fatal. Fixed policies retain immediate failure gates.
reason: A stale attempt with negative KSP reason must be allowed its one specified recovery, including a nonfinite stale residual.
